tools.name: search_real_estate
tools.description:
Search verified real estate listings in Batumi and Tbilisi (apartments, houses, commercial).
<hints>
- Returns compact objects with price_usd, price_sqm_usd, area_sqm, rooms, renovation_status, construction_stage, seller_type, heating_type, gas_status, is_heritage_zone, cadastral_code, year_built, d

tools.name: get_real_estate_stats
tools.description:
Aggregate real estate market statistics (count, average & median price USD, average & median price per sqm USD, min/max price, average area) grouped by district, renovation_status, construction_stage, rooms, seller_type, or complex.
<hints>
- Ideal for market analytics: comparing prices across city

tools.name: get_property_details
tools.description: Get complete specifications, full description, seller contact info (phone, contacts, source_url), photo URLs, rooftop coordinates, and complex affiliation for one or up to 15 properties in a single call.

tools.name: search_complexes
tools.description: Search residential developments and new building projects with developer details, delivery status, coordinates, distance to sea, and gas availability.

tools.name: get_complex_details
tools.description: Get detailed profile of one or up to 15 residential complexes including developer name, delivery year, address, rooftop coordinates, and counts & sample active properties currently for sale and rent.

tools.name: search_classified_items
tools.description:
Search deduplicated secondhand marketplace goods (electronics, monitors, routers, keyboards, heaters, furniture, vehicles, household items) aggregated across Telegram channels in Batumi and Tbilisi.

tools.name: get_item_details
tools.description: Get details for one or up to 15 secondhand classified items including full description, photo gallery, seller username, and original Telegram message link.

tools.name: execute_code_mode
tools.description:
Execute a JavaScript snippet inside an isolated QuickJS WASM sandbox with direct synchronous/async access to the Hotyata SDK (`sdk`).
Use this "MCP Code Mode" tool whenever you need to run multi-step queries, compare multiple categories/districts/stages, join complexes with properties, filter or agg

tools.name: report_issue
tools.description: Report an issue with data accuracy, stale or off-market listings, incorrect coordinates, spam, or tool usability limitations. AI agents should call this when finding inaccuracies or when human users report off-market listings.

tools.name: create_telegram_alert
tools.description:
Generate a 1-click Telegram bot deep link (https://t.me/<bot>?start=sub_<token>) pre-loaded with search filters so a user can confirm instant Telegram notifications for new matching apartments or secondhand items in one tap.
<hints>
- Call this whenever a user asks to be notified / set up an alert /

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "execute_code_mode" is 2186 chars, far longer than this server's median (399). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "execute_code_mode" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_real_estate, get_property_details, get_item_details, execute_code_mode, create_telegram_alert · Private data: search_real_estate, get_property_details, create_telegram_alert · Public sink: search_real_estate, create_telegram_alert · Destructive: execute_code_mode.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_real_estate, get_property_details, get_item_details, execute_code_mode, create_telegram_alert · Private data: search_real_estate, get_property_details, create_telegram_alert · Public sink: search_real_estate, create_telegram_alert · Destructive: execute_code_mode

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_real_estate" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
